ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the visible surface; localized high-intensity (white) pixels provide extreme focal contrast on the distal segments.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a consistent convex curve profile extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, thin, unaligned linear white streaks (rake-like marks) are visible on the mid-to-distal section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged irregularity and potential tissue erosion are visible on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
